decisions.decision: Swapped the planned 'credence' semantic linter for Styler (adobe/elixir-styler)
decisions.rationale: credence was 3 months old, 9.7K downloads, single maintainer, no CLI task (would need a hand-rolled wrapper around a non-public API). Styler does the same underlying job (auto-fix non-idiomatic Elixir) but is battle-tested: 3.6M downloads, 3 years old, Adobe-maintained, installs as a standard mix format plugin.

decisions.decision: mix quality is now a 7-step gate: hex.audit, deps.audit, deps.unlock --check-unused, format (Styler-augmented), credo --strict, sobelow, test --warnings-as-errors
decisions.rationale: Layered supply-chain (mix_audit) and idiomatic-code (Styler) checks on top of the existing Credo/Sobelow gate, prompted by a user-shared blog post on guarding against AI-generated code drift over time.

decisions.decision: Plan 01-01's BGG/R2 credentials live only in gitignored config/dev.secret.exs, resolved via PukllayClub.Catalog.Seed.Credentials.fetch!/0 (env var takes precedence over Application config)
decisions.rationale: Repo is public (Phase 0 D-19); credentials must never land in a tracked file, and the seed pipeline is dev/CI-only by design (never runs on the production host, so not routed through Kamal secrets).

decisions.decision: Wave/plan-level executor dispatch ran sequentially on the main working tree (not isolated worktrees) for all of Wave 1 (01-01) and Wave 2 (01-03)
decisions.rationale: 01-01 produces a gitignored local secret file that would be lost if created inside a temporary worktree later deleted; 01-03 auto-degraded to sequential because local main had diverged from origin/HEAD (worktree fork-base guard #1941/#683).
